settings.heading: THE ART OF TIMELESS FORM & PIGMENT
settings.subheading: Where monumental oil paintings, lost-wax bronze sculptures, and architectural 3D art models converge into private living galleries.

settings.title: MONUMENTAL OIL PAINTINGS
settings.description: Hand-stretched Belgian linen canvases prepared with traditional gesso ground, layered with rich natural mineral pigments and textured impasto techniques.

settings.title: BRONZE SCULPTURE & 3D MODELS
settings.description: Lost-wax cast bronze statuettes, carved marble figures, and three-dimensional architectural decorative models that command tactile reverence.

settings.title: AUTHENTIC PROVENANCE & CARE
settings.description: Every acquisition is numbered, registered, and accompanied by a museum certificate of provenance guaranteeing archival longevity for generations.

settings.heading: THE ATELIER MANIFESTO
settings.intro_text: In an era of disposable mass-produced decor, The Raw House was founded on an unapologetic conviction: True art possesses physical weight, tactile soul, and unhurried mastery.

settings.heading: HONORING THE WEIGHT OF CREATION
settings.paragraph_1: At The Raw House, we believe that an art piece is not merely an ornament—it is a tangible focal point that alters the energy and spatial geometry of an interior. Every oil painting begins with unhurried canvas stretching and mineral pigment blending, capturing luminous depth through dozens of textured impasto layers.
settings.paragraph_2: Our 3D sculptural models and bronze figures undergo traditional lost-wax foundry casting. Heated to over 1,200°C and hand-chiseled by master sculptors, each piece achieves a weighted presence and rich patina that mass machinery could never replicate.

settings.title: Mineral Sourcing & Canvas Priming
settings.description: Extracting rich earth minerals and fine oils to hand-mix archival glazes over heavy-weight Belgian linen canvases.

settings.title: Lost-Wax Foundry & Sculptural Form
settings.description: Pouring molten bronze at 1,200°C into refractory ceramic shell molds, followed by hand-chiseled detailing and hot patinas.

settings.title: Archival Framing & Ledger Registration
settings.description: Custom shadowbox hardwood framing and wax-sealed certificate of provenance registration in our master atelier ledger.

settings.title: White-Glove Crating & Installation
settings.description: Dispatched in bespoke museum-grade wooden crating with specialized transit and curatorial placement support worldwide.

settings.heading: FROM RAW MEDIUM TO PRIVATE GALLERY
settings.intro: Each artwork moves through an unhurried sequence of master artisan disciplines, ensuring every painting and sculpture holds authentic museum permanence.
